desc: Complete the bootstrap, chroot, binary, and source stages
u: lb build - Complete the bootstrap, chroot, binary, and source stages

lb build is a high-level command (porcelain) of live-build(7), the Debian Live tool suite.

lb build calls all necessary live-build programs in the correct order to complete the bootstrap, chroot, binary, and source stages.
lb build has no specific options but understands all generic live-build options. See live-build(7) for a complete list of all generic live-build options.

live-build(7)
